notes.title: Patch v.1.0.3.5224 released!
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Fixed a black screen on launch on some systems with low end GPUs

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.3.5209 released!
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Phone ring popup text now shows correctly in Chinese in the telephone closeup
Fixed some Chinese formatting related to the audio processing on the computer
The inventory can no longer lock up temporarily if the fridge is interacted with twice when playing in Chinese

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.0.3.5198 released!
notes.notes:
Changelog:
Reworked the padlock puzzle to feature an original solution more appropriate for Chinese
Resolved a few UI glitches when switching between Chinese and other languages
It is no longer possible to interact with the computer in the dorm room on day 3 using the floppy

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.3.5193 released!
notes.notes:
v.1.0.3.5193 Changelog:

Implemented Chinese language support (mouse and keyboard only)
Made sure the notebook can no longer rarely disappear after a certain conversation, resulting in a potential soft lock
Resolved a few Russian and German translation issues related to the audio analysis
The wrong dorm room number should no longer be recognized by the computer for Kathy and Eileen's room
When using a controller, password input on the computer is now shown in plaintext, for convenience
Took care of a slight visual glitch related to notebook entries being erased when not playing in English
A certain character portrait with a blank stare should now have a consistent display time in all languages
Re-added missing Croatian symbols in the credits to properly display the names of all contributors

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.2.5102 released, Русский теперь доступен!
notes.notes:
Changelog:


 Added Russian language support
 Fixed a rare soft lock related to picking up the envelope on the floor and spam skipping
 Resolved some fade issues related to skipping in the final forest scenes
 Kathy should no longer sometimes give an invalid denial message when combining tapes with the dictaphone
 When leaving the computer and using the controller, the virtual keyboard now properly fades out
 A certain door can no longer be lockpicked more than once
 Hotspots for two invisible characters should no longer appear off screen in the nature reserve on ultrawide aspects
 Various small translation tweaks and improvements

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.1.5026 released!
notes.notes:
Patch v.1.0.1.5026 changelog:

Engine:
 Updated our Unity version to 2019.4.31f to improve overall compatibility, stability and performance
 Added MacOS 12 Support

Gameplay and UI:
 Fixed a soft lock if the player picks up the flower and shovel in the nature reserve on day 3 but ignores the drawing
 Kathy can no longer get stuck if the player mashes the skip button as she is picking up the scarab
 Dragging a tape onto the dictaphone now won't result in an an occassional invalid denial message by Kathy
 The postcard is now blocked from being examined during an action sequence to prevent various glitches
 Fixed some odd game states related to saving and loading when viewing the postcard
 Optimized the sequence with the falling rocks to significantly improve the framerate
 The smokes are now deselected properly after successfully using them on a character with the controller
 It should no longer be possible to walk on top of the clinic doors with the controller
 Background subtitles in the jail now always fit within the camera when playing in narrow aspect ratios
 A character should no longer appear off screen when entering the jail in narrow aspect ratios
 Beau now properly turns to the right to face Kathy during their final conversation
 Fixed a glitched dictaphone UI state after some tapes were removed during the transition between days 2 and 3
 The notebook should no longer show an odd transition involving the phone numbers when adding a regular note on a few occasions

Audio:

 Lowered the super loud initial volume for the ambient gear sounds when entering a late game scene
 The music in the sheriff's station should now properly reset when re-entering the scene

Localization:

 Various translation fixes and improvements for German, French and Spanish

notes.title: v.1.0.0.4954 Hotfix live
notes.notes:
v.1.0.0.4954 Hotfix changelog:

 Fixed some voice overs (most notably Eileen's) not playing on systems with certain language settings.

notes.title: Kathy at Gamescom + Demo update
notes.notes:
We’ve got an updated demo of Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut going live for the duration of Gamescom. August 25 – August 27 you can check out a snippet of the updated version right here on Steam! 

If you have Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut added to your Steam wishlist you should get a notification when the demo goes live (and if you haven’t added it yet, here's a perfect time :wink:)
